message.content:
This magazine cover features an illustration of a man with an oversized head and a small body. He wears a bright yellow jacket over a white shirt and a dark tie. He is hunched in a room's corner with his knees pulled up, wearing black trousers. One hand is raised to his mouth with a finger between his lips. He wears thin-rimmed glasses and his eyes are wide. The setting includes a dark blue wall meeting a tiled floor with gray and white squares.

Large white text at the top reads “TEMPO” above the date “EDISI 26 November - 2 Desember 2001”. A red banner at the top edge contains white and yellow text: “Wawancara Agus Budiman, Korban Kepanikan AS?”. To the right of the figure, large yellow block letters read “AKBAR TERPOJOK SIAPA SENANG”. At the bottom, text states “MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN” and “Rp 10.800”. A barcode is in the bottom-left corner with numbers “00039” and “9 770126 427302”. The entire image is overlaid with thin, vertical multicolored lines.
